cast_style: CAST STYLE for the whole channel: simple round-headed cartoon people. Large white egg-shaped head, about one third of the body height, no hair unless stated. Two small solid black oval eyes, thick expressive black eyebrows, a small simple mouth, a tiny nose or none, no visible ears. Skin pure white with a bold black outline. Small simple bodies with slightly thick limbs and round mitten hands. Exaggerated comedic expressions. Ancient Greek clothing: tunics, sandals, bronze helmets.
eyes_rule: In every drawing the eyes stay two small solid black ovals: no white eyeballs, no eyelids. Show emotion with the eyebrows, the mouth and the whole body.
sheet_style: Clean professional 2D cartoon style for an adult comedy history channel. Bold confident black outlines with slight natural line-weight variation. Flat colors with only light cross-hatching in the shadows: no gradients, no soft shading, no texture, no cast shadows on the ground. Pure white (#FFFFFF) background everywhere, no paper texture, no vignette.
bg_style: Style: bold dark brown-black ink outlines with natural line-weight variation, loose cross-hatching in the shadows, slightly muted warm painted colors, soft directional light, clear depth with foreground, middle ground and background, subtle paper grain. No living characters, no people, no statues, no figures of any kind, no animals, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

characters.perseus: PERSEUS: a young hero in a bronze Corinthian helmet with a tall red horsehair crest, worn pushed up high on top of his head so his whole white egg-shaped face is visible, a cream tunic with a brown leather belt, a red cape, sandals, a round polished bronze shield and a short sword in a scabbard.
characters.soldier: THE SOLDIER: an ordinary Greek soldier in a blue tunic and a plain open-faced grey iron helmet.
characters.medusa_head: MEDUSA'S HEAD: green skin, angry glowing yellow eyes, a frown with small fangs, hair made of a dozen green snakes.
characters.acrisius: KING ACRISIUS (Perseus's grandpa): a skinny nervous old king, long grey beard reaching his belly, a small gold crown, a long purple robe with a gold border, sandals. Always looks a bit paranoid.
characters.danae: DANAE (Perseus's mother): a kind young woman with black hair in a simple bun, a pale blue ankle-length Greek dress (chiton) with a gold belt, sandals.
characters.polydectes: KING POLYDECTES: a fat smug king with a short dark brown beard around his jaw, a big gold crown, a long green robe with a gold border, a golden wine cup in one hand. Sleazy villain smile.
characters.athena: ATHENA, goddess of wisdom: a tall calm woman in a white dress, a bronze Corinthian helmet with a tall blue crest pushed up on her head, a small brown owl sitting on her shoulder. Unimpressed expression.
characters.hermes: HERMES, messenger god: a slim cheeky young man in a short orange tunic, a round grey traveller's hat with small white wings on the sides, small white wings on his sandals, a short golden staff with two snakes.
characters.medusa: MEDUSA: a gorgon woman with green skin, angry glowing yellow eyes, small fangs, hair made of a dozen green snakes, a ragged dark purple dress. Same head as in her reference image.
characters.andromeda: ANDROMEDA: a young princess with long black hair, a small gold tiara, an orange dress, gold bracelets.
characters.oracle: THE ORACLE: a mysterious priestess in a deep purple hooded robe that hides her hair, only the white face visible, sitting on a tall bronze tripod stool, purple smoke curling around her.
characters.baby_perseus: BABY PERSEUS: a tiny chubby baby with the same white egg-shaped head, wrapped in a white blanket, wearing a tiny bronze helmet with a tall red crest exactly like grown-up Perseus's.
characters.guest: PARTY GUESTS: plump Greek nobles in togas of different colors (white, yellow, light green) with laurel wreaths on their white egg-shaped heads, no helmets.
characters.nymph: A SEA NYMPH: a cheerful young woman with long wavy sea-green hair decorated with small seashells, a flowing light turquoise dress, barefoot.
characters.sea_monster: THE SEA MONSTER (Cetus): a huge goofy sea serpent, a long thick blue-green scaly neck and a big dragon-like head with small fins, round dumb eyes as two small solid black dots, big buck teeth, a tiny confused expression. Silly rather than scary.
characters.dictys: DICTYS, a kind fisherman: a chubby friendly middle-aged man with a short round brown beard, a floppy straw hat, a simple light brown tunic with rolled sleeves, a rope belt, bare feet. Warm, gentle expression.
characters.graeae: THE GRAEAE, three tiny ancient grey sisters: very old hunched women in ragged grey hooded robes, long stringy grey hair, wrinkled grey skin, completely EMPTY eye sockets drawn as two small dark hollows (no eyes at all), one single tooth each. Between the three of them they share ONE loose eyeball (white with a blue iris) that they pass by hand.
characters.gorgon_sister: GORGON SISTERS (Stheno and Euryale): like Medusa (green skin, snake hair, small fangs) but with bronze-scaled bodies and large golden bat-like wings on their backs, angry yellow glowing eyes.
characters.pegasus: PEGASUS: a cute white winged horse with big feathery white wings, a light blue mane and tail, two small black dot eyes, a happy surprised expression.
characters.atlas: ATLAS, a giant titan: a huge muscular bearded man with grey-blue skin, a short dark beard, a loincloth, holding up the round starry night sky on his shoulders and raised hands, grumpy expression.
characters.cassiopeia: QUEEN CASSIOPEIA: a vain glamorous queen with tall black hair piled up high, a big gold crown, a purple and gold gown, holding a hand mirror, smug nose-up expression.
characters.cepheus: KING CEPHEUS of Ethiopia: a thin nervous older king with a short grey beard, a small gold crown, an orange robe with gold trim.
characters.poseidon: POSEIDON, god of the sea: a big muscular god with a long wavy blue-green beard and hair, a gold crown, a sea-green robe, holding a golden trident, angry.
characters.phineus: PHINEUS, Andromeda's uncle: a scrawny middle-aged man with a long thin black moustache and a pointy beard, a dark red tunic, a bronze breastplate too big for him, holding a sword.
characters.zeus: ZEUS, king of the gods: a big burly god with a huge fluffy white beard and white bushy eyebrows, a white toga, a golden laurel wreath, holding a yellow zigzag lightning bolt, smug flirty grin.
